snippet.title: Leap: A Dragon's Adventure - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Fly through beautiful environments with a cute dragon in a relaxing platformer!
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rikzu.leap.dragons.adventure
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1581206969

Music: Journey to the Far Lands by Harris Heller - https://www.streambeats.com/

Leap: A Dragon's Adventure takes you to new beautiful worlds with many things to discover. In this mobile platformer, you'll be able to control a cute dragon and experience different environments while facing many difficult obstacles. You'll feel the freezing winds of the north, the relaxing vibes of Japanese land, and many other amazing places accompanied by amazing matching soundtracks.

Website: https://www.rikzugames.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/rikzugames/
Discord: https://discord.gg/jBawCAe

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rikzugames/
